newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends higher on deliveries, crop concerns.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends higher on deliveries, crop concerns.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended higher on Wednesday, recovering half the near-limit losses posted on Tuesday, on strong commercial stopping of deliveries and renewed crop concerns, traders said.

"Riceland stopped all the deliveries," a floor source said of the large commercial firm. "That held up the May. In the new crop, emergence is of some concern (in Arkansas and Texas). The bottom line is the crop is not off to a smooth start."
There were 235 lots of rice posted for delivery against the May on Wednesday, which was first notice day for deliveries.
Rice futures ended 13-1/2 to two cents per cwt higher with July up 11 at $11.35.
Volume was estimated by CBOT at 700 lots, compared with Tuesday's actual volume of 1,823.
